integrity: The formula was derived by Burnside counting and independently replayed by exhaustive fixed-content word enumeration for all tested cases with dk<=10.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-content bracelet enumeration is prior combinatorics; the claim of originality is the identification with Simon's quotient orbit profile and the orbit-growth consequence. Unindexed folklore remains possible.
title: Fixed-content bracelet orbit profiles for Simon’s circular finite-cover quotients
